_comment: NooPunk: Etsiva Romppainen ja Lakkahaltian Salaisuus. Portable case data: the same file feeds the Godot slice, a tabletop GM and later scenario tools. Rules data stays in data/rules/core.json; this file contains no dice math.
title: Etsivä Romppainen ja Lakkahaltian Salaisuus
subtitle: A NoöPunk detective case — Helsinki, 20XX, before the overt NHI Crisis

locations.name: Entrance
locations.prose: The ward's front door is unlocked. It should not be.

locations.name: Corridor
locations.prose: Fluorescent light, one bulb stuttering. The linoleum has been polished recently.

locations.name: Reception
locations.prose: A reception desk with a paper appointment book and a terminal that is not plugged in.

locations.name: Patient room 16
locations.prose: One bed, made. A mirror above the sink. The window looks into birch trees that are not on the site plan.

on_success.text: Two admissions on the same night, one file number, two different dates of birth. The second page is typed on a machine the ward does not own.

on_failure.text: The file resists a clean reading: pages are out of order and one line has been overtyped. You photograph what you can.

on_success.text: For a moment the reflection is a room with no door, and something small and many-eyed is sitting on the bed, eating cloudberry. Then it is only your own face, tired, and the birch trees outside.

on_failure.text: The glass shows the room and you in it. Nothing else. Your hands are shaking anyway.

record-1601.label: Medical record 1601
record-1601.prose: One file number, two admissions, two birth dates. The second page was typed on a machine the ward does not own.

nurse-inconsistency.label: The nurse's timeline
nurse-inconsistency.prose: Salmi says the ward closed in March. The duty roster in reception runs to June.

patient-testimony.label: Patient 16's account
patient-testimony.prose: She describes a visitor who came through the mirror and asked for cloudberries. She says the visitor was polite.

lakkahaltia-sighting.label: The thing in the mirror
lakkahaltia-sighting.prose: A small many-eyed figure in a room with no door. Cloudberry stain on the bed sheet matches nothing in the ward's stores.

closed_by_evidence.label: Close the case on the record
closed_by_evidence.prose: The file goes to UNSA with the inconsistencies intact and no explanation attached. The ward is closed pending audit. Patient 16 is transferred to a facility with better lighting. Nobody says the word 'anomaly'.

referred_anomalous.label: Refer the anomaly upward
referred_anomalous.prose: You attach the mirror account to the file under 'unresolved environmental factors'. It disappears into a queue you have never seen the end of. The birch trees are gone from the window by morning. The bed sheet still smells of cloudberry.

resolution.prompt: How does Romppainen close the case?
